title: Intersecting a curve in an abelian variety with multiples of another curve
summary: Levin asked what can be said about the locus of points lying on a given curve in $\mathbb{G}_m^n$ that have a non-zero integer multiple on another given curve in $\mathbb{G}_m^n$ for $n \geq 3$. We give a definite answer to the abelian analogue of Levin's question, proving what is predicted by the Zilber--Pink conjecture in this case. An important ingredient in our proof is a strengthening of a height inequality by Vojta and Rémond.
